verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਸੁਹਾਗਣ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਚ ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 16 : suhaagan dhe roop vich gursi'kh

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਡੁਲੀ ਮਾਊੂ ਪੀਊ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: pevakaRai ghar laaddulee maauoooo peeuoo kharee piaaree|

en.bdb: In her mother's home the girl is fondled and dearly loved by parents.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਭਿਰਾਵਾਂ ਭੈਨੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਸਪਰਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: vich bhiraavaa(n) bhainaRee naanak dhaadhak saparavaaree|

en.bdb: Among the brothers she is a sister and lives joyfully in the full fledged families of the maternal and the paternal grand fathers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖਾਂ ਖਰਚ ਵਿਆਹੀਐ ਗਹਣੇ ਦਾਜੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakhaa(n) kharach viaaheeaai gahane dhaaj saaj at bhaaree|

en.bdb: Then offering ornaments and dowry etc. and by spending hundreds of thousands of rupees she is married.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਣਖਤੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: saahuraRai ghar ma(n)neeaai sanakhatee paravaar sadhaaree|

en.bdb: In her father-in-law's house she is accepted with the title of married wife.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਛਤੀਹ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: sukh maanai pir sejaRee chhateeh bhojan sadhaa seegaaree|

en.bdb: She enjoys with her husband, eats variety of foods and always remains bedecked.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gun giaan vich aradh sareeree mokh dhuaaree|

en.bdb: From a temporal and spiritual point of view, women is half man's body and assists to the door of deliverance.
She assuredly brings happiness to the virtuous.
